title: 1:1 prep - Maya Thompson / Priya Shah
content:
Meeting: 1:1 prep
Manager: Maya Thompson
Direct report: Priya Shah (SWE-II)
Planned date: 2026-03-04
Duration: 30m
Location: Zoom / Slack huddle

Goals for this 1:1:
- Quick sync on priorities and blockers so I can unblock or re-route as needed.
- Career check: how Priya is feeling about scope and growth.
- Follow up on action items from last 1:1 (autoscale docs + flaky test triage).

Agenda (30m)
1) Quick personal check-in (3-5m)
   - How are things outside work? energy? time off coming?
2) Project updates (10m)
   - Autoscaling policy rollout (PLAT-482) — where we are, next steps
   - KV cache prototype perf numbers and rollout plan (PLAT-499)
   - Any surprises from staging or canary runs?
3) Blockers / needs (7m)
   - Infra quota request for dedicated CI GPUs (blocked since 2/20)
   - Flaky test suite on nightly (still flaky after Marcus's patch?)
4) Career / feedback (5m)
   - Check growth goals: ownership, mentoring, visibility
   - Quick feedback from my side: good impact on rollout, need more async updates
5) Action items + wrap (2-3m)

Notes / prep items for me (manager):
- Read latest PR #214 comments tonight (key thread about eviction policy).
- Remind Priya we can raise infra quota escalation if she hits >2 day blocker.
- Bring up potential stretch project: lead the quantization pilot for a sprint.

Status snapshots (Priya updates to confirm):
- Autoscale policy (PLAT-482): still on track for canary next week. Priya had to revert one change due to a regression in request routing. Need to confirm whether rollback is fully resolved.
- KV cache prototype: initial perf numbers show 12% median latency improvement but 2% higher p95 for long sequences; need to decide threshold for enabling on production.
- Flaky tests: Marcus opened a PR to isolate the test; Priya to confirm failing signals are not infra-related.

Blockers (to discuss):
- CI GPU quota request pending with infra (ticket INFRA-137). Priya needs at least 2 extra GPUs for performance runs. If not approved by Friday, we escalate to SRE lead.
- One user-facing bug seen during canary: truncation of long responses with specific tokenizer edge case. Priya proposed a workaround but wants to discuss long-term fix timeline.

Career / growth check (questions to ask Priya):
- How are you feeling about owning the autoscale rollout? Comfortable with stakeholder comms?
- Would you want more opportunities to mentor junior engineers? Any interest in running a short brown-bag on batching strategies?
- Any blockers to hitting your Q2 goal around system design exposure?

Feedback I want to give (short):
- Positive: strong follow-through on last-month on-call follow-up; your postmortem was clear and pragmatic.
- Area: we need more proactive status updates on async channels (thread in #platform-deploys) — small but helps me and PMs plan.

Action items (from this 1:1) - tentative
- Priya: Post a short summary in #platform-deploys after canary runs (due: 2026-03-06)
- Priya: Confirm CI GPU quota ETA and attach INFRA-137 to PLAT-482 (due: 2026-03-05)
- Maya: Review PR #214 comments and reply with decision on eviction approach (due: 2026-03-04 EOD)
- Maya + Priya: Decide safe threshold for KV cache enablement; schedule 30m design sync if needed (tentative: 2026-03-08)
- Marcus: Continue flaky test triage and update PR; Priya to verify after merge (linked: PR #226)

Follow-ups for next 1:1:
- Confirm canary metrics and decision on KV cache enablement.
- Check status on infra quota and any escalation needed.
- Quick career update: progress on Q2 system-design goal.

Misc notes / scratch: 
- Possible stakeholders to invite for canary review: Tom (SRE), Leila (Console), Jordan (Observability).
- If quota delayed, consider schedule perf runs during lower utilization window to reduce GPU need.
- Reminder: Priya asked about attending the internal "Designing for Scale" workshop on 3/12 — follow up on sign-up.

Unresolved questions to bring up in the meeting:
- Is the eviction approach in PR #214 safe for multi-tenant workloads? (I need input from Tom)
- Do we accept 2% p95 regression in exchange for 12% median improvement? What SLA guardrails do we set?

Quick to-dos after the 1:1 (for me):
- If Priya asks to escalate, ping SRE lead and include cost/benefit note for extra GPUs.
- Draft intro blurb for Priya if we assign her to lead the quantization pilot (2-3 sentences).

Last 1:1 action items (status):
- Priya: Write draft autoscale runbook — in progress (50%).
- Maya: Connect Priya with Leila for console metrics dashboard — done (intro email sent 2026-02-28).

End of prep notes.
